## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 19, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _dark gory_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using the app for about a year, and it used to be excellent. However, with the new update, I am finding it difficult to use my "hearts" because 1,200 of them have been frozen in my account; I am also having trouble making payments within the app. I hope the app returns to how it used to be."
            2. _Farangiz_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "Very much detailed! Love how it's accurate as possible to every character. But has slight freezes and too much ads! Edit: solid 1 star. Everything should be paid now! They even removed the daily prizes."
            3. _Natalia Carlos Diaz_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "The update regarding hearts and the "check-in" feature was terrible. As someone who has been using Doki Chat for a long time, freezing the daily hearts felt like a low blow; I mean, that feature helped drive regular visits to the app and served as a sort of reward. Now, everything has to be paid for. Sure, you can still get hearts by watching ads, but having to sit through them is annoying. It was—and still is—the best app, but those updates... 🤢Please remove the payment "check-in" update"
